final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals), first_kept AS (SELECT t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.avg_pulse_rate), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(f.avg_pulse_rate - o.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_overall_average, AVG(f.avg_pulse_rate - s.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_second_average FROM first_kept AS f CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE f.avg_pulse_rate > s.avg_pulse_rate
